name: Tangent USD
oneLiner: USG is Tangent's debt token minted against productive DeFi collateral (Curve LP, Pendle PTs), with Peg Keepers and dynamic-interest borrowers defending the peg.
collateral: Over-collateralized productive DeFi collateral, including Curve Finance LP tokens, Pendle PTs, and other yield-bearing or LP positions from protocols such as Curve, Convex, Stake DAO, and Spectra.
pegMechanism: USG has no collateral redemption path. Tangent targets the peg with Peg Keeper contracts, price-dependent reward deductions, and dynamic interest: HEC borrowers can be interest-free while USG stays above each market's threshold but lose more collateral rewards as USG falls, while LEC borrowers pay price-dependent interest immediately.

reserves.name: Productive DeFi collateral (Curve LP tokens, Pendle PTs, and related LP/yield positions)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified USG source exposes burnDebt(address,uint256), callable by owner-managed burner roles, and burns from the supplied address without holder allowance. That is direct holder-balance burn/seizure authority.

mintAuthority.summary: USG is minted by approved Tangent markets, IR producers, and peg-keeper routes; a 3/4 Tangent Safe owner can grant and revoke those roles.

controls.label: USG token role-gated mint functions
controls.capDescription: Verified source restricts mintDebt to isMinter, mintIR to isIRProducer, and mintPegKeeper to owner-approved peg keepers.
controls.evidence: Source review showed mintDebt, mintIR, and mintPegKeeper guarded by isMinter, isIRProducer, and onlyOwner. Ethereum reads returned controlTower() = 0xF3f7669dcEED2f985815011C19eD68F667267215 and owner() = 0x461B62CB3A7e9Df8f800aE058AE92F855F2c27Ca at block 25166611.

controls.label: Tangent owner Safe
controls.evidence: Safe API returned threshold 3, four owners, no modules, and zero guard on 2026-05-24.

review.evidence: USG source and docs support a CDP/peg-keeper mint path controlled by owner-managed role mappings.
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate current isMinter, isIRProducer, and isPegKeeper addresses from events before final production edit.

launchPhaseDetail: Five audit reports are referenced in docs (Sherlock, Egis, Pashov x2, plus Zerocool AI audit); beta testing is still disclosed; Ethereum token contract is live with nonzero supply, while the public site still shows placeholder APY/TVL metrics and no CoinGecko or DefiLlama market row is available yet
